## Change

Describe what this changes and which engineering concern it addresses (architecture, lab, security, cost, troubleshooting, or interview content).

## Verification

- [ ] `python3 scripts/check.py` passes
- [ ] `terraform fmt -check` and `terraform validate` pass, if Terraform was changed
- [ ] Any new lab includes objective, prerequisites, steps, verification, cleanup, and cost
- [ ] No employer, customer, account, credential, or unwanted personal information is included
- [ ] Links between docs are accurate and were checked
